# Customizing Layer5 Cloud Deployment with Helm

Layer5’s Helm charts support a number of configuration options. Please refer to following table of configuration options.

Kratos configuration to use. You can pass your own Kratos configuration file and configure self-service flows, enable/disable features as required. (Kratos Reference Configuration)[https://www.ory.sh/docs/kratos/reference/configuration] for detailed description of each fields. kratos.kratos.config.ciphers object {&quot;algorithm&quot;:&quot;xchacha20-poly1305&quot;} One of the values: [noop, aes, xchacha20-poly1305]. Default if not provided is noop. kratos.kratos.config.secrets.cookie list [&quot;&quot;] Fill in values for cookie and cipher to be used in the AuthN flows kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.flows.login.lifespan string &quot;720m&quot; Each session is valid for a set amount of time. This time is the session&rsquo;s lifespan. When the session lifespan expires, the user must re-authenticate. kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.flows.recovery.lifespan string &quot;720h&quot; In the configuration, session lifespan is expressed in hours, minutes, and seconds. Use a combination of these units to define the desired lifespan. For example: 72h, 10m, 12s, 1h13m3s. kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.flows.registration.lifespan string &quot;24h&quot; Each session is valid for a set amount of time. This time is the session&rsquo;s lifespan. When the session lifespan expires, the user must re-authenticate. kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.flows.verification.lifespan string &quot;720h&quot; In the configuration, session lifespan is expressed in hours, minutes, and seconds. Use a combination of these units to define the desired lifespan. For example: 72h, 10m, 12s, 1h13m3s. kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.methods.oidc.config.providers[0].client_id string &quot;&quot; GitHub OAuth App client_id to enable GitHub OIDC support for cloud IDP. kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.methods.oidc.config.providers[0].client_secret string &quot;&quot; GitHub OAuth App client_secret to enable GitHub OIDC support for cloud IDP. kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.methods.oidc.config.providers[0].mapper_url string &quot;file:///home/ory/identity/oidc.github.jsonnet&quot; mapper_url is a jsonnet file to map the incoming OIDC profile details to the Kratos Identity. kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.methods.oidc.config.providers[0].scope list [&quot;read:user&quot;,&quot;user:email&quot;] GitHub OAuth App scope&rsquo;s to specify exactly what type of access you need. Scopes limit access for OAuth tokens. They do not grant any additional permission beyond that which the user already has. kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.methods.oidc.config.providers[1].client_id string &quot;&quot; Google OAuth App client_id to enable Google OIDC support for cloud IDP. kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.methods.oidc.config.providers[1].client_secret string &quot;&quot; Google OAuth App client_secret to enable Google OIDC support for cloud IDP. kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.methods.oidc.config.providers[1].mapper_url string &quot;file:///home/ory/identity/oidc.google.jsonnet&quot; mapper_url is a jsonnet file to map the incoming OIDC profile details to the Kratos Identity. kratos.kratos.config.selfservice.methods.oidc.config.providers[1].scope list [&quot;email&quot;,&quot;profile&quot;] GitHub OAuth App scope&rsquo;s to specify exactly what type of access you need. Scopes limit access for OAuth tokens. They do not grant any additional permission beyond that which the user already has. kratos.kratos.identitySchemas.&ldquo;identity.schema.json&rdquo; string &quot;{\n\&quot;$id\&quot;: \&quot;identity.schema.json\&quot;,\n\&quot;$schema\&quot;: \&quot;http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#\&quot;,\n\&quot;title\&quot;: \&quot;Person\&quot;,\n\&quot;type\&quot;: \&quot;object\&quot;,\n\&quot;properties\&quot;: {\n \&quot;traits\&quot;: {\n \&quot;type\&quot;: \&quot;object\&quot;,\n \&quot;properties\&quot;: {\n \&quot;email\&quot;: {\n \&quot;type\&quot;: \&quot;string\&quot;,\n \&quot;format\&quot;: \&quot;email\&quot;,\n \&quot;title\&quot;: \&quot;E-Mail\&quot;,\n \&quot;minLength\&quot;: 3,\n \&quot;ory.sh/kratos\&quot;: {\n \&quot;credentials\&quot;: {\n \&quot;password\&quot;: {\n \&quot;identifier\&quot;: true\n }\n },\n \&quot;verification\&quot;: {\n \&quot;via\&quot;: \&quot;email\&quot;\n },\n \&quot;recovery\&quot;: {\n \&quot;via\&quot;: \&quot;email\&quot;\n }\n }\n },\n \&quot;name\&quot;: {\n \&quot;type\&quot;: \&quot;object\&quot;,\n \&quot;properties\&quot;: {\n \&quot;first_name\&quot;: {\n \&quot;title\&quot;: \&quot;First Name\&quot;,\n \&quot;type\&quot;: \&quot;string\&quot;\n },\n \&quot;last_name\&quot;: {\n \&quot;title\&quot;: \&quot;Last Name\&quot;,\n \&quot;type\&quot;: \&quot;string\&quot;\n }\n },\n \&quot;required\&quot;: [\n \&quot;first_name\&quot;,\n \&quot;last_name\&quot;\n ]\n },\n \&quot;avatar\&quot;: {\n \&quot;title\&quot;: \&quot;Avatar URL\&quot;,\n \&quot;type\&quot;: \&quot;string\&quot;\n }\n },\n \&quot;required\&quot;: [\n \&quot;email\&quot;,\n \&quot;name\&quot;\n ],\n \&quot;additionalProperties\&quot;: true\n }\n}\n}&quot;
